_doc.about: The crew trait library (docs/CONTENT_PLAN.md section 2). A trait is a bag of generic keys; scripts/crew/traits.gd (TraitSet.of) merges the bags of a crew member's species, personal traits (data/crew.json `traits`, by name) and worn gear into numbers, and every rule that a key changes reads them there. Packs add traits in their own traits.json, in this shape. Merging: factors multiply (a trait with no entry for a key leaves it alone), amounts add, `mechanical` is true if any trait says so, ion_stun and the dries_out threshold take the strongest. A species entry (data/species.json) may carry the same keys inline, merged first. A trait with no keys (suit) is only a label that abilities.gd checks against operator_needs. `name` and `blurb` are for the UI. The old place for traits, the `traits` table of species.json with a `mult` object (no_air_damage, fire_damage, repair_time as a time factor, heal_others), is still read for ids this file does not define.

keys.hp_mult: factor on the species' max hp, applied when the species is set
keys.speed_mult: factor on the species' walk speed, applied when the species is set
keys.o2_use: factor on the air they breathe (BREATH_RATE per second); 0 = does not breathe, and so cannot suffocate
keys.suffocate_mult: factor on the damage they take in a room with no air
keys.damage_taken: factors on the damage they take, by source: fire (standing in a burning cell), no_air, ion (an ion hit on their room: crew.json ion_hp per point), melee and ranged (kept for the on-foot fights, nothing reads them yet)
keys.work_mult: factors on the SPEED of their work (2 = twice as fast), by job: repair (a part, or a crewmate with `mechanical`), extinguish, breach, man (how well they work a post, times station.manned_mult), heal_others (reviving a crewmate), restock and craft (kept for jobs that do not exist yet)
keys.heal_mult: factors on what a bed and a medbay heal them (0 = it does not)
keys.mechanical: true: beds do not heal them; a hurt one gets a repair_crew job (priority 75) that any other crew member does
keys.aura: what they give to the room they stand in while up: o2_per_s (air added), heal_per_s (hp for everyone in the room), work_mult (factor on the work speed of the OTHERS in the room)
keys.station: power_bonus: the part they man gets this much power while they man it (added to its figure, so a consumer draws less); manned_mult: factor on the bonuses a manned helm, weapon or shield gives
keys.melee_mult: factor on their melee damage (kept for the on-foot fights)
keys.ranged_mult: factor on their ranged damage (kept for the on-foot fights)
keys.swarm: work speed +per_other for every OTHER up crew member of the same species in their room, at most +max
keys.dries_out: they lose hp_per_s hit points a second in a room whose hottest part is above heat_above
keys.ion_stun: seconds they are stunned (no walking, no work) when an ion hit lands on their room

suit.name: Suited
suit.blurb: Wears an EVA suit: the label abilities ask for.

fast_repair.name: Quick hands
fast_repair.notes: repair and breach time x0.6, which is a work speed of 1/0.6
